items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: Dick Gibson, when we came up there to do his jazz party, he insisted, on, “I have a good piano player for you.” I said, “I’m the piano player.”

ctx.x: Dick Gibson, when we came up there to do his jazz party, he insisted, on, “I have a good piano player for you.” I said, “I’m the piano player.” He said, “You didn’t do it on your records.” He had been playing our records for about four years on his radio show.
